user-registration-diagram.title: User Registration Diagram
user-registration-diagram.definition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant A as Express API
    participant R as Router / Middleware
    participant CO as Controller
    participant V as Validator
    participant OS as OTP Service
    participant ES as Email Service
    participant H as Argon2id
    participant Repo as Repository
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    Note over C,DB: 1. Request Registration OTP
    C->>A: POST /register/otp
    A->>R: Route + Middleware
    R->>CO: Forward request
    CO->>V: Validate email + username
    V-->>CO: Valid data
    CO->>OS: sendRegistrationOtp(email, username)
    OS->>OS: Generate 6-digit OTP
    OS->>OS: SHA-256 hash OTP
    OS->>ES: Send OTP email
    ES-->>C: Verification email
    OS->>Repo: Create / replace OTP record
    Repo->>DB: INSERT / UPDATE OTP
    DB-->>Repo: Success
    Repo-->>OS: Success
    OS-->>CO: OTP sent
    CO-->>C: 200 otp_sent

    Note over C,DB: 2. Verify Registration OTP
    C->>A: POST /register/verify-otp
    A->>R: Route + Middleware
    R->>CO: Forward request
    CO->>V: Validate email + OTP
    V-->>CO: Valid data
    CO->>OS: verifyOtp(email, otp, registration)
    OS->>OS: SHA-256 hash submitted OTP
    OS->>Repo: Get OTP record
    Repo->>DB: SELECT OTP
    DB-->>Repo: OTP record
    Repo-->>OS: OTP record
    OS->>OS: Check expiry + code + verified state
    OS->>Repo: Mark OTP verified
    Repo->>DB: UPDATE verified = TRUE
    DB-->>Repo: Success
    Repo-->>OS: Success
    OS-->>CO: OTP verified
    CO-->>C: 200 otp_verified

    Note over C,DB: 3. Create Account
    C->>A: POST /register
    A->>R: Route + Middleware
    R->>CO: Forward request
    CO->>V: Validate email + password + username + OTP
    V-->>CO: Valid data
    CO->>OS: Check registration OTP verified
    OS->>Repo: Get OTP verification state
    Repo->>DB: SELECT verified
    DB-->>Repo: Verification state
    Repo-->>OS: verified = TRUE
    OS-->>CO: Authorized
    CO->>H: Hash password with Argon2id
    H-->>CO: Password hash
    CO->>Repo: Create user
    Repo->>DB: INSERT user
    DB-->>Repo: User created
    Repo-->>CO: Success
    CO->>Repo: Delete registration OTP
    Repo->>DB: DELETE OTP
    DB-->>Repo: Success
    Repo-->>CO: Success
    CO-->>C: 201 account_created

    Note over C,DB: Registration fails if OTP is missing, expired, incorrect, or unverified

user-login-diagram.title: User Login Diagram
user-login-diagram.definition:
sequenceDiagram
  actor Client
  participant API as Express Api
  participant MW as Router/Middleware
  participant Ctrl as Controller
  participant Val as Validator
  participant Svc as Service
  participant Argon as Argon2id
  participant Token as TokenSvc
  participant Repo as Repository
  participant DB as Database
  Client ->> API: POST /login
  API ->> MW: Request
  MW ->> Ctrl: Request
  Ctrl ->> Val: req.body
  Val -->> Ctrl: Validated data / throws ValidationError
  Ctrl ->> Svc: Validated data
  Svc ->> Repo: Find user by email
  Repo ->> DB: Query user
  DB -->> Repo: User row (id, hashed password)
  Repo -->> Svc: User record
  Svc ->> Argon: Verify(password, hash)
  Argon -->> Svc: match result
  alt password matches
    Svc ->> Token: Generate session token
    Token ->> Repo: Store hashed token
    Repo ->> DB: Insert session
    Token -->> Svc: token
    Svc -->> Ctrl: token
    Ctrl -->> MW: Set-Cookie + 200 Success
    MW -->> Client: 200 Success
  else user not found or password mismatch
    Svc -->> Ctrl: throw AuthError
    Ctrl -->> MW: next(err)
    MW -->> Client: 4xx Error response & log
  end

default-diagram.title: Default Placeholder Diagram
default-diagram.definition:
sequenceDiagram
  actor Client
  participant API
  participant DB
  Client->>API: request
  API->>DB: query
  DB-->>API: result
  API-->>Client: response
